criteria.provisional_diabetes: 126 mg/dL or higher on more than one occasion
criteria.diabetes_hba1c: 6.5% or higher confirmed by repeat testing

prediabetes_and_diabetes.guidance: Lifestyle interventions (nutrition, 150 min/wk moderate physical activity) are first-line. Metformin may be considered for prediabetes if BMI >= 35 or history of GDM. Clinician evaluation required.

criteria.optimal_ldl: Less than 100 mg/dL (< 70 mg/dL in high risk)

dyslipidemia.guidance: Calculate 10-year ASCVD risk before initiating statin pharmacotherapy. Address secondary causes such as diabetes, thyroid dysfunction, and medication effects.
